Before you fund an account properly, deposit small and test a withdrawal. Save this for the next time someone sends you a 'great broker'.

title: Easy to deposit. Hard to withdraw?
text:
Headline: Easy to deposit. Hard to withdraw?
Supporting line: Withdrawal complaints are the most common red flag in trader reviews. Read them first.
Footer: Read the reviews before you deposit.
caption: Deposits are instant. Withdrawals are where brokers show who they are. Delays, extra documents, "bonus terms" that lock your balance. Read the withdrawal reviews first.

title: A licence badge proves nothing.
text:
Headline: A licence badge proves nothing.
Supporting line: Anyone can paste one on a website. The regulator's register is the only proof.
Footer: Check the register, not the badge.
caption: A regulator's logo on a website is an image. Anyone can paste one. The only proof is the regulator's own register, and it takes two minutes to search.

title: How a Trust Score is built
text: Carousel, 7 slides: What's inside a Trust Score? / 01 Regulation / 02 Reviews / 03 Transparency / 04 Footprint / 05 Complaints / No pay-to-rank. Read the methodology.
caption:
What's inside a Trust Score? Five factors: regulation, reviews, transparency, footprint and complaints. The formula and weights are published on our methodology page, and no broker can pay to move up.

A score is where your research starts, not a recommendation.

title: Meet TrustBrokerHub
text: Carousel, 6 slides: 38,680 brokers. Which one do you trust? / 38,680 brokers and exchanges in one database / 105 regulators across 140 countries / A Trust Score on every broker / Scam alerts, trader reviews, side-by-side compare / Look them up before you pay them.
caption:
38,680 brokers and exchanges. One question before you deposit: who are you actually dealing with?

TrustBrokerHub checks forex brokers, crypto exchanges and prop firms against 105 regulators in 140 countries. Every broker gets a transparent Trust Score, and scam alerts, reviews and a compare tool sit in one place.

Search any broker before you deposit. Link in bio.

title: Top broker. According to who?
text:
Headline: Top broker. According to who?
Supporting line: Not every broker ranking tells the full story.
Footer: Look beyond the ranking.
caption: "Top broker" is a claim, not a fact. Most lists never say who paid for the position or what was measured. Before a ranking convinces you, ask what sits behind it.
